manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.population: 16 fresh complete operational mappings balanced as {'supersedes': 8, 'supplements': 8}
manifest.selection: Eight wholly fresh immutable references and operational request clauses were frozen before tokenizer import and crossed with both relations. Each English arm states the source's complete registered meaning and exclusions; no bare or abbreviated English control is used.
manifest.method: Compute Ainglish minus complete-English tokens for every pair under each pinned encoding; average within each form stratum, weight form strata equally, and report the maximum encoding mean.

estimand.population: the 16 fresh complete pairs retained in this manifest
estimand.aggregation: equal form-stratum mean per tokenizer; headline is the maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: the proposal's complete careful-English mapping, never bare or abbreviated English
estimand.interpretation: token cost only; no claim about comprehension, fidelity, reference validity, or adoption

manifest.freeze: The API retained the canonical manifest before this process imported tiktoken or observed token counts.
